verdict.rationale: Factory clearly integrates with repositories (Droid CLI, Factory App working directories, Git workflow, quickstart docs) and connects to team systems including MCP tools, implying some repo onboarding, but no evidence explicitly describes a 'one-click' repo-connection flow or app installation process comparable to a GitHub App install. Missing for 10: explicit one-click GitHub/GitLab app install flow, screenshots or docs of a simplified repo authorization step, and confirmation that setup requires no manual configuration.
